'''2000 RPG Outpost tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at RPG Outpost on 2000. [[Scott Lingrell]] won it. It is known from Scott Lingrell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3522">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-23-rpg-outpostd3522/ rpg-outpost], DeckTech (Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell, 23 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-23-rpg-outpostd3522/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2000
* '''Site:''' RPG Outpost
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
